hero.label: Oversight
hero.title: Continuous Monitoring & Accountability
hero.desc: Active oversight mechanisms that protect operators and ensure compliance throughout the platform lifecycle.

features.title: Operator Monitoring
features.text: Ongoing monitoring of operational health, compliance posture, and governance adherence throughout the platform lifecycle.

features.title: Reporting Requirements
features.text: Mandatory reporting from operators. Operational updates, compliance status, and material event disclosures per framework terms.

features.title: Dispute Resolution
features.text: Established procedures for complaints and disputes. Escalation paths and resolution mechanisms built into framework terms.

features.title: Early Warning System
features.text: Automated monitoring of compliance triggers, operational metrics, and communications. Proactive alerts for deviations.

info_blocks.title: Governance Framework
info_blocks.intro: CCASH platform includes governance provisions protecting all parties:

info_blocks.title: Multi-Party Controls
info_blocks.intro: No single person can make critical changes unilaterally:
items: Multiple approvers required: Sensitive operations need sign-off from independent keyholders
Recorded decisions: Every approval is logged with an immutable audit trail
Separation of duties: The people who propose changes aren't the same people who approve them
info_blocks.outro: This isn't bureaucracy for its own sake. It's protection against insider threats, compromised accounts, and honest mistakes.
